## What does it mean to say a package supports automatic differentiation?

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="46%"}
- We do not think there is a community standard for what supporting
  automatic differentiation means
- So we aimed to build our own, using
  `DifferentiationInterfaceTest`[lk-differentiationinterfacetest]
- `SpecialFunctions.jl` is the example. `gamma_inc` and `beta_inc` carry
  no derivative rules, so support is janky across backends
- `EpiAwareADTools.jl` stores our org-wide automatic differentiation
  fixes, and deletes each one when upstream ships it

::: {.callout-note}
Is there a guide for any of this anywhere in the Julia ecosystem? I went
looking and did not find one.
:::
:::
::: {.column width="54%"}
```julia
DIT.test_differentiation(
    [backend], ok;
    correctness = true,
    type_stability = :none,
    scenario_intact = scenario_intact,
    rtol = rtol, atol = atol
)

check_broken(broken_scens, backend; rtol, atol)
```
